<content>
1: // Asteroid Escape game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
6: 
7: // Audio assets
8: const boostSound = new Audio('boost.mp3');
9: const explosionSound = new Audio('explosion.mp3');
10: const bgMusic = new Audio('bgm.mp3');
11: bgMusic.loop = true;
12: bgMusic.volume = 0.5;
13: bgMusic.play();
14: 
15: // Ship
16: const ship = {
17:   x: 50,
18:   y: canvas.height / 2,
19:   w: 30,
20:   h: 20,
21:   speed: 3,
22:   boostSpeed: 6,
23:   fuel: 100,
24:   maxFuel: 100,
25: };
26: let up = false, down = false, boosting = false;
27: 
28: // Asteroids
29: const asteroids = [];
30: let asteroidTimer = 0;
31: const asteroidInterval = 90; // frames
32: 
33: let score = 0;
34: let gameOver = false;
35: 
36: function spawnAsteroid(){
37:   const radius = 15 + Math.random()*15;
38:   const y = Math.random()*canvas.height;
39:   const speed = 2 + Math.random()*2;
40:   asteroids.push({x: canvas.width+radius, y, radius, speed});
41: }
42: 
43: function update(){
44:   if (gameOver) return;
45:   // ship movement
46:   if (up) ship.y -= ship.speed;
47:   if (down) ship.y += ship.speed;
48:   if (boosting && ship.fuel>0){
49:     ship.y -= ship.boostSpeed;
50:     ship.fuel -= 0.5;
51:   } else {
52:     ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.maxFuel, ship.fuel + 0.2);
53:   }
54:   ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
55: 
56:   // asteroids
57:   asteroidTimer++;
58:   if (asteroidTimer > asteroidInterval){
59:     spawnAsteroid();
60:     asteroidTimer = 0;
61:   }
62:   for (let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
63:     const a = asteroids[i];
64:     a.x -= a.speed;
65:     if (a.x + a.radius < 0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
66:     // collision (simple rect-circle)
67:     const dx = Math.max(ship.x, Math.min(a.x, ship.x+ship.w));
68:     const dy = Math.max(ship.y, Math.min(a.y, ship.y+ship.h));
69:     const dist = Math.hypot(a.x-dx, a.y-dy);
70:     if (dist < a.radius) {gameOver = true;}
71:   }
72:   if (ship.fuel <= 0 && boosting) gameOver = true;
73: 
74:   score += 0.016; // approx per 60fps seconds
75: }
76: 
77: function draw(){
78:   ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
79:   // ship
80:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
81:   ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
82:   // boost fuel bar
83:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
84:   ctx.fillRect(10,10, ship.fuel, 5);
85:   // asteroids
86:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
87:   asteroids.forEach(a=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();});
88:   // score
89:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
90:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
91:   ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score), canvas.width-120, 20);
92:   if (gameOver){
93:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
94:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
96:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
97:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2-80, canvas.height/2);
98:   }
99: }
100: 
101: function loop(){
102:   update();
103:   draw();
104:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
105: }
106: 
107: // input handling
108: window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
109:   if (e.key==='ArrowUp') up = true;
110:   if (e.key==='ArrowDown') down = true;
111:   if (e.key===' ') boosting = true;
112: });
113: window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
114:   if (e.key==='ArrowUp') up = false;
115:   if (e.key==='ArrowDown') down = false;
116:   if (e.key===' ') boosting = false;
117: });
118: 
119: loop();
